programs.name: Master of Business Administration (MBA)
programs.feeNote: Approved fee structure for batch 2027-29 (Indian students): academic fees Rs 8,76,000 per annum, paid as 4 instalments of Rs 4,38,000 (2 per year) = Rs 17,52,000. Excludes refundable institute deposit Rs 20,000, refundable hostel deposit Rs 20,000, mess Rs 1,58,600 p.a. and hostel Rs 1,91,900 (three-sharing) to Rs 3,35,800 (single) p.a. in year 1; hostel fees may rise up to 15% a year; government taxes extra. Discretionary-quota seats pay double academic fees.
programs.intakeNote: Not stated on the pages used.
programs.placementNote: SIBM Hyderabad Final Placement Report, Batch 2023-2025 (infographic on the institute's placement report page): average CTC 9.1 LPA, median CTC 8.2 LPA, highest 31 LPA, top decile 11.6 LPA, top quartile 10 LPA; 82 participating recruiters. The 2024-26 report page was empty on 2026-11-12. Audit not stated.

selectionProcess.name: SNAP 2026 test
selectionProcess.weightage: 50 marks (SNAP score out of 60 scaled to 50)
selectionProcess.detail: Register for SNAP 2026 and separately for SIBM Hyderabad (institute registration fee Rs 1,000); shortlisting declared 15 Jan 2027.

selectionProcess.name: Personal Interaction (PI)
selectionProcess.detail: Plus 10 marks for institute-specific parameters; merit list out of 100; first merit list 1 Mar 2027.

selectionWeightage.note: Merit-list weightage as shown on SIBM Hyderabad's selection procedure page (WAT column is commented out of the live table).

keyDates.notes: SNAP 2026 registration & payment closes 25 Nov 2026; SNAP CBT 13, 19 and 26 Dec 2026; SNAP result 12 Jan 2027; SIBM Hyderabad registration closes and shortlist declared 15 Jan 2027; GE-PI slot booking 22-25 Jan 2027; GE-PI 12-14 & 18-21 Feb 2027; first merit list 1 Mar 2027; fee deadline 31 Mar 2027; programme starts 7 Jun 2027 (tentative).
